summary: Declare GitHub author cohorts once for native rolling and civil-day objectives

replay.detail: Existing authored objective bodies retain repeated author-login children and their declaration revisions. Canonical GitHub facts and bounded projection replay are unchanged; no history conversion or new replay cursor is required.

schema.detail: Declaration grammar extension only. No claim kind/field, registry digest, generated docs/st3/schema.md entry, SQLite table/index/user_version, or include_str lane input changes. The existing desired body stores the selector. Corpus allocation remains v43, owned by the coordinated corpus slice; this change allocates no version.

rules.detail: Optional authorLogins emits canonical sorted unique lowercase author-login children. Omission retains all-author semantics. Known nonmatching authors are excluded from native rolling-hour counts, fourteen civil-day bars and final-ready latency. Missing author evidence, conflicting canonical images and incomplete roster coverage remain unknown, never zero.

compatibility.detail: N-1 evaluators without the selector grammar reject selected declarations and report no-data rather than silently evaluating all authors. Existing declarations without selectors preserve meaning. Publish selected declarations only to upgraded evaluators; shared measurement row fields and GitHub capture wire records are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or offline migration is required by this declaration/evaluation change.

manual.detail: Cohort membership belongs in the owning objective declaration, not dashboard consumers. No private cohort, observer, acquisition activation or target is installed by default.

recovery.detail: Measurements recompute from canonical facts and authored selector policy. Corrections, retractions and coverage gaps retain existing recovery semantics.
